title: Wither Storm Hat - For Foxes
description: Give your pet foxes a cute custom 3D Wither Storm Hat.
body:
Have you ever looked at your pet fox and thought, "You know what's missing? The world-ending power of the Wither Storm!" Look no further. This resource pack introduces a custom 3D Wither Storm Hat designed exclusively for your favorite fox companions.



Features:

Custom 3D Model: A custom Blockbench model built from scratch.

Fox-Friendly Design: Specifically tilted and scaled so your foxes actually wear the hat on their heads instead of just holding it sideways in their teeth.

All Ages Welcome: Works perfectly for both fully grown adult foxes and tiny baby fox cubs.



Good to Know:


Q. Will it be for players?
A. No. Players don't get this one! This is strictly, explicitly, and specifically a hat for your cute fox pets. It will not render on human player models.


Q. Does it work with OptiFine?
A. I don't know buddy! For me the game didn't load with OptiFine for some reason. So, find out yourselves.


Q. Will it be for further versions?
A. If I will be in the mood pal.



How to Get it In-Game

Getting your fox kitted out in end-game gear is incredibly simple:


Craft or grab a standard vanilla Leather Cap.
Place it inside an Anvil.
Rename the cap exactly to: Wither Storm Hat
Drop the newly named hat on the ground right in front of your pet fox.
Watch your cute fox trot over, scoop it up, and instantly wear it. This works for both grown and young foxes.



Required Dependencies:


To make this custom 3D pack display properly in your game, you must use a CIT mod. Standard vanilla Minecraft will just show a boring brown leather hat.


For Fabric Players:

CIT Resewn


For Forge Players:



Forge CIT



Have fun with this one! Hope you all enjoy it!
